answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph: a node’s voting weight is the probability mass reaching it from trusted seeds. A sybil cluster may resemble a lagoon, ocean, or nebula of identities, yet an external cut with conductance φ gives an escape bound typically O(tφ) over t steps; min-cut transitivity therefore limits the cluster’s aggregate voting weight and collusive amplification.
